function ensureStarCloud(s, THREE): void;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/star-cloud.ts:177

Lazy-loads the real star field once per boot — fired fire-and-forget from bootstrap after the body graph exists, so the 1.5 MB binary streams in the background and the cloud fades in on the disc when it decodes. No-ops on repeat calls, dispose, or fetch failure.
